answer: An AI economy resists Sybil attacks by anchoring reputation to a singular, immutable identity point. Legitimate agents form dense, interconnected clusters, whereas attackers spawn isolated, low-trust nodes like walnuts. These footholds lack the robust structural connections of the main network trellis, rendering them unable to influence market outcomes. By penalizing any isolated node attempting to inject itself into the trellis, the system ensures that only verifiable, multi-linked identities dictate access, forcing attackers to burn capital on worthless Sybils.
